Subject: Discovery recap + scheduling the technical deep dive

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next step below.

Recap (TL;DR)
- Use case: MedixHealth wants a scalable inference layer for patient-summary generation and clinical search.
- Primary constraints: sub-200ms 95th/latency for single-turn generation, sensitive PHI retention policies, SOC 2 evidence required for procurement.
- Current infra: managed GCP + on-prem data connectors for older records.

Proposed next step
- 60–90 minute technical deep dive with engineering + security to walk architecture, performance expectations, and deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).
- Goal: align on feasibility and identify any blockers for a POC.

Possible windows (all PT) — please confirm which works for your team and attendees:
- Tue, May 26 — 9:00–10:00 AM PT
- Wed, May 27 — 1:00–2:00 PM PT

Can you confirm: 1) which slot works, 2) preferred meeting platform (Zoom vs Google Meet), and 3) final attendee list we should invite? I attached a short agenda we can use as a starting point.

Attachments: RDW-Medix-discovery-agenda.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Karthik
